text: The Dallas Mavericks are an American professional basketball team from Dallas, Texas. They play in the National Basketball Association (NBA). They were founded in 1980. They play their home games at the American Airlines Center. The team's main owners are casino magnates Miriam Adelson and her son-in-law Patrick Dumont, who bought a majority stake in the team from Mark Cuban in December 2023. Cuban still has a minority interest and controls basketball operations. Although the franchise was competitive for most of the 2000s, the Mavericks have only made the NBA Finals three times. The first time was in 2006, when they lost to the Miami Heat 4-2. They won their first NBA Championship in 2011 when they beat the Miami Heat in a 4-2 series in a rematch from 2006. After the championship, the Mavericks did not make it past the second round of the playoffs until 2022. They faced the Boston Celtics in the 2024 NBA Finals, losing in five games. Notable Mavericks players include Dirk Nowitzki, Jason Kidd, Steve Nash, Michael Finley, Mark Aguirre, Sam Perkins, Derek Harper, Jerry Stackhouse, Peja Stojaković, Jason Terry, Shawn Marion, Tyson Chandler, Brendan Haywood, Caron Butler , Rolando Blackman, Luka Dončić, Kyrie Irving and Cooper Flagg.
title: Dallas Mavericks

text: Shirley Todd Huffman (July 22, 1928 – July 1, 2018) was an American Republican politician. She was born in Dayton, Oregon. She later moved to Hillsboro, Oregon, where she served on the city council before serving two terms as mayor from 1985 to 1993. After leaving office, she was replaced by Gordon Faber and served on the board of directors for TriMet and as a development coordinator for the city. Huffman died on July 1, 2018 in Ventura, California from natural causes at the age of 89.
title: Shirley Huffman

text: Roelof Johannes Nelissen (4 April 1931 – 18 July 2019) was a Dutch politician and businessman. He was a member of the Catholic People's Party (KVP) (now the Christian Democratic Appeal). He was born in Hoofdplaat, Netherlands. Nelissen was the Deputy Prime Minister from 1971 to 1973 and Minister of Finance at the same time during the Barend Biesheuvel ministry. He was the CEO of the AMRO Bank from 1983 to 1991. Nelissen died on 18 July 2019 in Hilversum, Netherlands at the age of 88.
title: Roelof Nelissen

text: On 3 June 1849, French troops led by Marshal Nicolas Oudinot made a second attack on Rome during the struggle between the French forces and the Roman Republic. The attack came suddenly, without warning, as the French hoped to break into the city quickly and restore the Pope’s rule. However, the defenders of Rome, commanded by Giuseppe Garibaldi, fought back fiercely. There were heavy battles around the walls and gates of the city, and the Roman fighters managed to stop the French once again. After hard fighting, the French troops were forced to retreat. Later French troops surrounded Rome, blocked supplies, and started siege operations to weaken the defenders over time. This marked the beginning of a long and difficult struggle that would eventually lead to the fall of the Roman Republic later in July 1849.
title: Second Siege of Rome
